sample_unit: questions derived from ESC 2024 AF guideline recommendations

links.outcome: LLM classification reliability and consistency across prompting strategies, languages, and repeated runs
links.effect: Fleiss kappa 0.449 to 0.763 across LLM-prompt combinations (moderate to substantial); best consistency 60.3% (Claude 3.5 with P-COT); no significant English vs Chinese differences in most combinations.
links.quote: The reliability of the different LLM-prompt combinations showed moderate to substantial agreement (Fleiss kappa ranged from 0.449 to 0.763).

unlisted_practices: Comparing prompting strategies (IO, 0-COT, P-COT) for LLM guideline-recommendation classification

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating LLM performance on cardiology guideline questions comparing different prompt engineering strategies (input-output vs zero-shot CoT vs performed CoT) and languages.
